stem: Which of these best illustrates how much the general public knew about the Navajo code immediately following World War II?

options.label: F
options.text: Its application in World War II as a clandestine system of communication was one of the twentieth century's best-kept secrets.

options.label: G
options.text: A hand grenade was "potato," and plain old bombs were "eggs."

options.label: H
options.text: That was the situation in 1942 when the Pentagon authorized one of the boldest gambits of the war.

options.label: J
options.text: Each Talker was so valuable, he traveled everywhere with a personal bodyguard.
